input.rationale: The diff fixes Quaternion.from_rotation_matrix. For 180-degree rotation matrices it used to multiply every vector component by sign(0) and return the zero quaternion. It now uses a leading_sign helper that falls back to the symmetric off-diagonal terms. Both candidates report this bug fix correctly, under the right algebras header. Candidate A adds a clause about 'eliminating premature branching'. That branching existed only in an earlier draft of this PR, never in a release, so the clause is an implementation detail that misleads users about what changed. Candidate B is short, clear, and states the user-visible result: the method now returns a unit quaternion.
